documents.title: CAS case note, March 5, 2026
documents.text:
[Page 1]
Case note — home visit March 5, 2026, 2:15 p.m.
Worker: T. Brandt.
Child (age 4) observed playing in living room. Child appeared well-fed and appropriately dressed.
Mother cooperative. No concerns noted during the visit.

documents.title: Affidavit of T. Brandt, sworn April 9, 2026
documents.text:
[Page 1]
I, T. Brandt, make oath and say:
1. I attended the family home on March 5, 2026.
2. During that visit the child appeared thin and inadequately dressed for the weather.
3. Based on my observations, I am concerned that the child's basic needs are not being met.
